The documents don't answer this. All eight are race results from 2000, 2022, and 2024, and Jenson Button appears only as a finisher (in the 2000 German, Belgian, French and Japanese Grands Prix). None shows him winning a race, so they can't tell me which season was his first win or who took that year's constructors' title.

From memory, not the documents, his first win was the 2006 Hungarian Grand Prix, and Renault won the 2006 constructors' championship. That is outside the provided information, so I haven't used it as the answer.

ANSWER: none
